proof_summary: At \(n=473165\), the intermediate value \(5292270077783=a(473165)+4\) is Sierpiński: a period-48 covering of the exponent residues by divisors from \(\{3,5,7,17,97,257,673\}\) shows that \(5292270077783\cdot2^j+1\) is composite for every positive \(j\). Since this value lies strictly between the two proposed consecutive endpoints, it disproves their consecutiveness.
